caveats: Region grid is 60x60 cells (lat 57.84-59.02 N, lon 17.42-18.60 E); 3294 cells had finite SST on all 92 target days (sea cells) and 306 land cells (SST never finite) which are set to 0. Thresholds/climatology: per day of year, pool of all SST values within +/-5 calendar days of each baseline date (1992-2002) with that day of year (121 values/day, including edge extensions 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05; Feb-29 values fall in neighbours' windows); 90th percentile computed with numpy method='hazen' as specified, mean for climatology; day 60 set to mean of days 59 and 61; both smoothed with a centred 31-day circular moving mean. A day is hot when SST (K) >= smoothed threshold for that day of year; per-cell MHW = run of >=5 consecutive hot days restricted to 2008-06-01..2008-08-31, joined across 1-2 day gaps (gap days included); regional events are maximal runs of days with at least one cell in an MHW. Two readings of the gap-joining rule (gap of <=2 days vs <=2 non-hot days) give identical results for this region/period. All arithmetic in float64.
